lines.zh: 挥动着闪亮的翅膀飞过。
lines.en: Flaps its glowing wings past.
Gently flaps away from you.

lines.zh: 翅膀发出轻微的沙沙声。
lines.en: Wings rustle softly.
Skims low over the ground.
Zips through the forest.
Drifts in the air, dreamlike.
Gleams in the sunlight.
Soars freely in the wind.
Seeks the next landing.
Flies towards the distant horizon.
I glide between the floating islands.
My wings are wet with Aether dew.
Perches quietly on flowers.
Wings tremble slightly.
Stares at its surroundings.

lines.zh: 第九只蝶停在水晶棱上理翅。
lines.en: The ninth butterfly preens on a crystal edge.
Enjoys its peaceful moment.
Suspends itself in the air.
Wings flutter gently.
Naps in the sun.
Gently flaps wings.
Occasionally flaps wings.
I spread my wings to the sun.
I rest on the rim of a crystal.
I groom my antennae with my forelegs.
I wait for the wind to bring pollen.
发出 warning chirps at you.
Stares at you, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 似乎对你的存在感兴趣。
lines.en: Appears interested in you.
Moves closer to you.
Appears wary of you.
Observes your every move.
Nervously approaches you.
Seems to want to get closer.
Issues a warning chirp at you.
Remains wary of you.
I circle above your head.
I land on your offered hand.
My compound eyes see a dozen of you.
I dart close to your face and back off.
I follow your torch.
I pause on your shoulder a moment.

lines.zh: 翅膀的影子落在你脸上
lines.en: My wing shadow falls on your face.
I can hear your voice.

lines.zh: 翅膀受了伤，慢慢飞不动了。
lines.en: Wings are injured, can't fly far.

lines.zh: 翅膀被撕裂了，疼痛难忍。
lines.en: Wings are torn, painful.
Wings are broken, hard to fly.
Wings damaged, flying slower.
Wings injured, can't fly far.
Wings hurt, flying slow.

lines.zh: 翅根被削掉一角，我得歇一会儿。
lines.en: A corner of my wing base is gone — I need to rest.
Wings injured, hard to fly.
Powder from my wings dusts your hand.
My wing dust fell; I can't fly straight.

lines.zh: 它那闪烁的触须诱惑着你靠近。
lines.en: Its shimmering触须引诱你靠近。

lines.zh: 你忍不住被它的美丽所吸引。
lines.en: You can't resist its beauty.
It gently touches your fingers.

lines.zh: 它在你耳边低语，引你走向未知。
lines.en: It whispers to you, leading you to the unknown.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀反射出微光，吸引着你。
lines.en: Its wings shine, drawing you in.
You are enchanted by its mystery.

lines.zh: 它的声音像是来自另一个世界的呼唤。
lines.en: Its voice calls from another world.

lines.zh: 它在你耳旁轻语，试图带你穿越。
lines.en: It whispers near your ear, trying to lead you through.

lines.zh: 它的存在让你感到既危险又诱惑。
lines.en: Its presence feels both dangerous and tempting.

lines.zh: 它用它的美丽引诱你走向死亡。
lines.en: It lures you to your death with its beauty.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它那坚硬的翅膀。
lines.en: You collide with its hard wings.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在空中发出嘎吱声。
lines.en: Its wings creak in the air.

lines.zh: 它轻巧地从你身边掠过。
lines.en: It gracefully skims past you.
It seems to deliberately bump into you.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它的坚硬外壳。
lines.en: You collide with its hard shell.

lines.zh: 它用翅膀的边缘划过你的皮肤。
lines.en: Its wing edges scratch your skin.
It tries to entangle you with its触须。

lines.zh: 你感觉到它的触须触碰你的脸。
lines.en: You feel its触须touch your face.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀刮擦着你的衣服。
lines.en: Its wings scrape against your clothing.
My wing knocks against your armor.

lines.zh: 它寻找伴侣，翅膀发出细微的声音。
lines.en: It searches for a mate, wings making soft sounds.

lines.zh: 它的触须在空中寻找伴侣。
lines.en: Its触须reach out for a mate in the air.

lines.zh: 它在空中发出求偶的鸣叫。
lines.en: It发出求偶的鸣叫 in the air.

lines.zh: 它以优雅的方式扇动翅膀吸引伴侣。
lines.en: It attracts a mate with graceful wing movements.

lines.zh: 它试图用触须与伴侣触碰。
lines.en: It tries to touch its partner with its触须。

lines.zh: 它以独特的方式扇动翅膀，寻找伴侣。
lines.en: It searches for a partner by fluttering its wings uniquely.

lines.zh: 它的求偶声回荡在空气中。
lines.en: Its求偶声回荡 in the air.

lines.zh: 它与伴侣一起飞翔，翅膀交织在一起。
lines.en: It flies with its partner, wings intertwined.
Two butterflies dance in the air.
I brush antennae with a mate.

lines.zh: 茧破而出，新生的天境蝴蝶缓缓展开透明羽翼。
lines.en: The cocoon breaks, and the new Heaven Butterfly slowly unfurls its transparent wings.

lines.zh: 它用触须轻触，似乎在确认自己是否安全。
lines.en: It gently touches with its antennae, as if checking if it’s safe.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻颤，仿佛在享受风的拥抱。
lines.en: Its wings tremble lightly, as if enjoying the wind’s embrace.

lines.zh: 它轻轻扇动翅膀，试图融入周围的环境。
lines.en: It gently flutters its wings, trying to blend into the surroundings.

lines.zh: 幼虫开始在黑暗中蠕动，寻找破茧而出的时机。
lines.en: The larva begins to wriggle in the darkness, seeking the moment to break free.

lines.zh: 突然，它感受到了猎物的气息。
lines.en: Suddenly, it senses the prey’s presence.

lines.zh: 它在空中盘旋，寻找下一个目标。
lines.en: It circles in the air, searching for its next target.

lines.zh: 天境蝴蝶发出微弱的荧光，照亮了周围的黑暗。
lines.en: The Heaven Butterfly emits a faint glow, illuminating the surrounding darkness.

lines.zh: 它轻巧地在空中漂浮，仿佛不需任何支撑。
lines.en: It floats gracefully in the air, as if needing no support.

lines.zh: 它在夜晚的光线下显得更加幽灵般透明。
lines.en: It appears even more ethereal and transparent under the moonlight.

lines.zh: 那猎物的气味真好，让我捕食吧。
lines.en: The prey’s scent is good. Let me hunt.

lines.zh: 我找到了它的踪迹，它在哪儿？
lines.en: I’ve found its trail. Where is it?

lines.zh: 我感知到了它的气息，就在附近。
lines.en: I can sense its presence nearby.

lines.zh: 猎物在树林中移动，它不会察觉。
lines.en: The prey moves in the forest. It won’t notice.

lines.zh: 它就在我视线中，准备攻击。
lines.en: It’s in my sights. Ready to strike.

lines.zh: 猎物似乎发现了我，快靠近！
lines.en: The prey has noticed me. Get closer!

lines.zh: 现在就是攻击的最佳时机。
lines.en: Now’s the best time to attack.
I’m about to enjoy this hunt.

lines.zh: 它正靠近，我的机会来了。
lines.en: It’s getting closer. My chance comes now.

lines.zh: 我已经锁定目标，准备行动。
lines.en: Target acquired. Action ready.
The smell of nectar drifts by.
The flower field lies below.
Something moves among the ruins.

lines.zh: 你包里的果香把我引过来了。
lines.en: The fruit scent in your pack pulled me over.
My gaze settles on your pack.
Found it, right there.

lines.zh: 目标已经锁定，等待最佳攻击时机。
lines.en: Target locked. Wait for the best opportunity.

lines.zh: 我会优雅地结束它的生命。
lines.en: I will end its life elegantly.
I will attack with the wind.

lines.zh: 它将无法逃脱我的触角。
lines.en: It will not escape my antennae.

lines.zh: 我将用我的毒刺结束它的生命。
lines.en: I will use my stinger to end its life.

lines.zh: 它在黑暗中毫无察觉，我会悄无声息。
lines.en: It’s unaware in the darkness. I’ll strike silently.

lines.zh: 我会用我的触须缠绕它。
lines.en: I will wrap it with my antennae.

lines.zh: 我将用我的翅膀扇动它。
lines.en: I will fan it with my wings.
My attack will be lethal.

lines.zh: 我将用我的毒液制服它。
lines.en: I will subdue it with my venom.
I lower myself for a dive.
I circle, waiting for it to stray.
My wings tense, ready.
I drift quietly behind it.
I line up with the wind.
I hover two blocks above it.
My antennae keep twitching.
One more wingbeat and I strike.

lines.zh: 它那双闪着绿光的眼睛盯着你！
lines.en: Its glowing green eyes lock onto you!
Its antennae swing at you!

lines.zh: 突然张开巨大的翅膀，向你扑来！
lines.en: It suddenly opens its enormous wings and lunges at you!

lines.zh: 尖刺触角狠狠地刺向你！
lines.en: Its spiky antennae pierce you with viciousness!

lines.zh: 翅膀边缘的锯齿刮过你的皮肤！
lines.en: Its serrated wings scrape against your skin!

lines.zh: 触须缠绕住你，试图将你拉入洞穴！
lines.en: Its antennae wrap around you, trying to pull you into the cave!

lines.zh: 闪烁着寒光的触角向你挥舞！
lines.en: Its icy antennae swing at you!

lines.zh: 翅膀拍击发出恐怖的响声！
lines.en: Its wings beat with a terrifying sound!
It quickly approaches, ready to attack!

lines.zh: 翅膀上的锯齿切割你的皮肤！
lines.en: Its serrated wings slice your skin!
I jab with my antennae.
My wings stir a burst of turbulence.
I ram it from the side.
I dust its eyes with scale powder.
My thin legs seize it.
I bite down and hold.

lines.zh: 一撮鳞粉先飘下来，然后是我。
lines.en: A puff of scale dust falls first, then me.

lines.zh: 天际线中闪现一抹黑影！
lines.en: A shadow flickers on the horizon!
It leaps out from the ground cracks!
It appears at the mouth of a distant cave!

lines.zh: 黑暗中传来微弱的呢喃声！
lines.en: A faint whispering sound comes from the darkness!
It slowly walks out of the cave!
It emerges from the distant shadows!
It appears in the dark corner!
It materializes in a faint light!

lines.zh: 从黑暗的缝隙中探出头来！
lines.en: It peeks out from the dark crevice!
I pupate in the Aether grass.
A seam splits in the cocoon.
One wing pushes out first.
Scale dust fills the air.
I rise from the island's edge.
Sunlight hits my new wings.
The Aether gains one more butterfly.
I wake above the flowers.
Burned by fire, painful.

lines.zh: 从高处跌落，翅膀受了伤。
lines.en: Fall from height, wings hurt.
Drowned, wings damaged.
Exploded, wings hurt.
Hit by arrow, wings hurt.

lines.zh: 法术击中翅膀，疼痛难忍。
lines.en: Hit by magic, painful.

lines.zh: 饿得翅膀无力，飞不动了。
lines.en: Starved, wings weak, can't fly.

lines.zh: 雷电击中翅膀，疼痛难忍。
lines.en: Lightning hit, painful.
Fell into void, wings hurt.
